function roOne<T>(input: T | readonly [T]): T[] { return []; }
function roOpt<T>(input: T | readonly [T,T?]): T[] { return []; }
function mutOne<T>(input: T | [T]): T[] { return []; }
function mutOpt<T>(input: T | [T,T?]): T[] { return []; }
function starts<T>(input: T | [T, ...T[]]): T[] { return []; }
function ends<T>(input: T | [...T[], T]): T[] { return []; }
function middle<T>(input: T | [T,...T[],T]): T[] { return []; }
function shape<T>(input: readonly [T]): T { return input[0]; }
const array: number[] = [1,2];
const readonlyArray: readonly number[] = [1,2];
const prefix: [number,...number[]] = [1,2];
const suffix: [...number[],number] = [1,2];
const both: [number,...number[],number] = [1,2];
const a: number[][] = roOne(array);
const b: number[][] = roOpt(array);
const g: [number,...number[]][] = ends(prefix);
const h: [...number[],number][] = starts(suffix);
const i: [number,...number[]][] = middle(prefix);
const j: [...number[],number][] = middle(suffix);
const k: number[] = starts(prefix);
const l: number[] = ends(suffix);
const m: number[] = middle(both);
const p: number[] = ends([1,2]);
const q: number[] = starts([1,2]);
console.log(a,b,g,h,i,j,k,l,m,p,q);
function viaShape<T>(input: T | { value: T; kind: 'structured' }): T[] { return []; }
const rec = { value: 1, label: "record" };
const right = { value: 1, kind: 'structured' as const, label: 'right' };
const disjoint: (typeof rec)[] = viaShape(rec);
const matching: number[] = viaShape(right);
console.log(disjoint, matching);
